chhattisgarh.whyGo: Open-air art museum and park in Naya Raipur — Holidify list; state tourism theme.
chhattisgarh.paceNote: Level walk. Sit. Not stacked with Ghatarani.

chhattisgarh.name: Ghatarani Waterfalls
chhattisgarh.whyGo: Raipur-district picnic fall on Holidify’s top-22.
chhattisgarh.paceNote: Own morning. Spray and steps. Skip Barnawapara the same day.

chhattisgarh.name: Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary
chhattisgarh.whyGo: Sanctuary on Holidify #1 and Wikipedia’s wildlife list (~Mahasamund side).
chhattisgarh.paceNote: Cool morning jeep if offered. Own outing from Raipur.

chhattisgarh.name: Bhoramdeo Temple
chhattisgarh.whyGo: ‘Khajuraho of Chhattisgarh’ near Kawardha — Holidify and Wikipedia temple lists.
chhattisgarh.paceNote: Northwest extra. Own night. Not a Raipur afternoon.

chhattisgarh.name: Mainpat
chhattisgarh.whyGo: Underrated hill station on Holidify — Surguja side.
chhattisgarh.paceNote: Far north extra. Own nights. Not this three-hotel week.

chhattisgarh.name: Achanakmar Wildlife Sanctuary
chhattisgarh.whyGo: Tiger reserve ~60 km from Bilaspur on Holidify / Wikipedia.
chhattisgarh.paceNote: Bilaspur-side extra. Own lodge. Not stacked with Sirpur.

manipur.name: Kangla Fort
manipur.whyGo: Ancient citadel of Manipur’s kings — Incredible India Imphal lead.
manipur.paceNote: Grounds walk. Sit. Not stacked with Govindajee the same afternoon.

manipur.name: Shree Shree Govindajee Temple
manipur.whyGo: Serene capital temple on Incredible India’s Manipur / Imphal list.
manipur.paceNote: Cover shoulders. Quiet morning. One temple outing.

manipur.name: Imphal War Cemetery
manipur.whyGo: WWII cemetery on the official Imphal attractions list.
manipur.paceNote: Quiet memorial. Sit. Separate from Kangla.

manipur.name: Ima Keithel (Mother’s Market)
manipur.whyGo: Women-run market highlighted on Incredible India’s Manipur page.
manipur.paceNote: Short sit-down visit. Not a shopping marathon after a fort morning.

manipur.name: Manipur State Museum
manipur.whyGo: Indoor history halt on the Imphal attractions list.

manipur.name: Loktak Lake
manipur.whyGo: Largest freshwater lake in the Northeast — floating phumdis on Incredible India.
manipur.paceNote: Boat from a jetty when offered. Sit. Cool hours.

meghalaya.name: Shillong Peak / Ward’s Lake
meghalaya.whyGo: Hill-capital vistas on Meghalaya Tourism’s Shillong and 1-day scenic cards.
meghalaya.paceNote: Lake or peak — not both plus Elephant Falls the same afternoon.

meghalaya.name: Don Bosco Museum
meghalaya.whyGo: Indoor museum on the official museum circuit.
meghalaya.paceNote: Quiet rooms. Rain-day halt. Not stacked with a waterfall.

meghalaya.name: Elephant Falls
meghalaya.whyGo: City-outskirts fall on official Shillong nature loops.
meghalaya.paceNote: Short extra if the city day stayed easy. Spray and steps.

meghalaya.name: Mawphlang Sacred Grove
meghalaya.whyGo: Guided grove on official 5-day and Shillong extras.
meghalaya.paceNote: Own morning from Shillong. Short loop. Not a trek.

meghalaya.name: Nohkalikai Falls
meghalaya.paceNote: One fall a morning. Viewpoint, not a scramble.

meghalaya.name: Nohsngithiang (Seven Sisters Falls)
meghalaya.whyGo: Named on Meghalaya Tourism’s waterfall list.
meghalaya.paceNote: Pick Nohkalikai or Seven Sisters. Not both plus a cave.

nagaland.name: Dimapur
nagaland.whyGo: Usual air/rail gate before the Kohima hill road — Tourism Nagaland circuit start.
nagaland.paceNote: Plains rest night. No Kohima climb on arrival if tired.

nagaland.name: Naga Heritage Village (Kisama)
nagaland.whyGo: Tribal house cluster / morungs — official Destinations post.
nagaland.paceNote: Walk and sit. Not stacked with the war cemetery the same morning.

nagaland.name: Kohima War Cemetery
nagaland.whyGo: WWII memorial in the hill capital — quiet level outing.
nagaland.paceNote: Sit often. Separate morning from Kisama.

nagaland.name: Dzulekie
nagaland.whyGo: Nature village near Kohima on Tourism Nagaland Destinations.
nagaland.paceNote: Extra from Kohima. Short visit. Not with Dzükou.

nagaland.name: Tuophema Tourist Village
nagaland.whyGo: Model rural-homestay village on the Destinations list.
nagaland.paceNote: Own overnight extra. Not a Kohima afternoon stack.

nagaland.name: Dzükou Valley
nagaland.whyGo: Cloud meadow trek on Tourism Nagaland’s Destinations blog.
nagaland.paceNote: Serious trek. Later trip. Not this comfort week.

mizoram.name: Aizawl viewpoints
mizoram.whyGo: Ridge capital on Wikipedia’s Tourism in Mizoram town list.
mizoram.paceNote: One viewpoint morning. Sit. Not stacked with Hmuifang.

mizoram.name: Hmuifang Tlang
mizoram.whyGo: Hill ~50 km from Aizawl; virgin forest reserved since Mizo chiefs’ time.
mizoram.paceNote: Own morning. Short walks. On the way toward Lunglei — not a scramble.

mizoram.name: Dampa Tiger Reserve
mizoram.whyGo: Largest sanctuary / tiger reserve ~127 km west of Aizawl on the Wikipedia wildlife list.
mizoram.paceNote: Own nights. Not an Aizawl day trip.

mizoram.name: Reiek Tlang
mizoram.whyGo: Hill station ~12 km from Aizawl; valley views, Bangladesh plains on a clear day.
mizoram.paceNote: Lodge rest. Short paths to viewpoints. Sit often.

mizoram.name: Reiek Heritage Village
mizoram.whyGo: Cultural village at the Reiek tourist area on Wikimedia / local tourism photos.
mizoram.paceNote: Short village walk. Not a summit push if tired.

mizoram.name: Vantawng Falls
mizoram.whyGo: Falls ~5 km south of Thenzawl on Wikipedia’s Thenzawl list — mid-state extra.
mizoram.paceNote: Own outing toward Thenzawl. Viewpoint, not a gorge scramble.

tripura.name: Ujjayanta Palace
tripura.whyGo: Gleaming white Manikya palace in the capital — Tripura Tourism destination lead.
tripura.paceNote: Indoor rooms and grounds. Light-and-sound only if energy is high.

tripura.name: Jagannath Bari / capital temples
tripura.whyGo: Jagannath, Laxmi Narayan, and related capital shrines on Explore Tripura Day-1.
tripura.paceNote: One temple morning. Not stacked with the palace.

tripura.name: Sepahijala Wildlife Sanctuary
tripura.whyGo: Near-Agartala sanctuary on the destination list.
tripura.paceNote: Cool morning. Follow posted zoo/park rules. Not with Ujjayanta if tired.

tripura.name: Chaturdasha Devata (14 Gods)
tripura.whyGo: West of Agartala on Pilgrim and Eco packages.
tripura.paceNote: Own outing. Not stacked with Kamalasagar the same morning.

tripura.name: Jampui Hills
tripura.whyGo: Highest hill range; Eden Tourist Lodge nights on Eco / Explore packages.
tripura.paceNote: Far hill extra. Own nights. Not this three-hotel week.

tripura.name: Tripura Sundari Temple (Matabari)
tripura.whyGo: Ancient Matabari temple — official destination and Pilgrim Tour lead.
tripura.paceNote: Cover shoulders. Sit. Not both Neermahal and Gunabati the same day.

haryana.name: Sultanpur National Park
haryana.whyGo: Bird park on the Gurugram plains — the gentle wildlife morning.
haryana.paceNote: Cool hours, short trails. Not stacked with Damdama the same day.

haryana.name: Damdama Lake
haryana.whyGo: Aravalli reservoir near Gurugram, listed for recreation.
haryana.paceNote: Viewpoint or still lunch. Skip kayak/balloon stacks.

haryana.name: Surajkund
haryana.whyGo: Lake, sun-temple remains, and the February crafts mela.
haryana.paceNote: One outing. Mela season is crowded — sit often.

haryana.name: Raja Nahar Singh Palace
haryana.paceNote: Indoor rooms if the sun is hard. Not after a long highway day.

haryana.name: Brahma Sarovar
haryana.whyGo: The great tank of Kurukshetra — level pilgrim walk.
haryana.paceNote: Sit on the ghats. Skip a second temple if tired.

haryana.name: Jyotisar
haryana.whyGo: Traditional site of the Bhagavad Gita sermon.
haryana.paceNote: Short visit after the sarovar — not both plus the panorama in one loop.

chandigarh.name: Capitol Complex
chandigarh.whyGo: UNESCO modern architecture on Chandigarh Tourist Places list.
chandigarh.paceNote: Visiting hours. Sit. Not with Rock Garden same afternoon.

chandigarh.name: Sukhna Lake
chandigarh.whyGo: Shivalik foothill reservoir on the official list.
chandigarh.paceNote: Promenade sit. Shade. Rose Garden extra.

chandigarh.name: Rose Garden
chandigarh.whyGo: Zakir Hussain Rose Garden — botanical shade on the list.

chandigarh.name: Rock Garden
chandigarh.whyGo: Nek Chand’s sculpture garden on Chandigarh Tourist Places.

jammu-and-kashmir.name: Srinagar
jammu-and-kashmir.whyGo: Valley capital on the Jhelum — rest base for the circuit.
jammu-and-kashmir.paceNote: Arrive and unpack. No hill drive on day one.

jammu-and-kashmir.name: Dal Lake
jammu-and-kashmir.whyGo: Shikara and houseboats on the lake.
jammu-and-kashmir.paceNote: One hour on the water. Not a full-day garden stack.

jammu-and-kashmir.name: Mughal gardens
jammu-and-kashmir.paceNote: Shade and sitting. Skip a second garden if tired.

jammu-and-kashmir.name: Gulmarg gondola
jammu-and-kashmir.whyGo: Meadow and snow bowl west of Srinagar.
jammu-and-kashmir.paceNote: Weather window. Not the same day you arrive from the plains.

jammu-and-kashmir.name: Sonamarg
jammu-and-kashmir.whyGo: Meadow on the way toward Zoji La.
jammu-and-kashmir.paceNote: Day trip only if roads are kind; otherwise overnight.

dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.name: Moti / Nani Daman Fort
dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.whyGo: Portuguese forts on Incredible India Daman notes.
dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.paceNote: One fort precinct. Beach another outing.

dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.name: Diu Fort
dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.whyGo: Island fort — Incredible India Diu lead.

dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.name: Nagoa Beach
dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.whyGo: Golden beach on Incredible India Diu list.
dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.paceNote: Beach hour. Sit. Not with fort heat if tired.

dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.name: Dudhni / Vanganga lakes
dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.whyGo: Inland lakes on Incredible India Silvassa notes.
dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu.paceNote: Boat or gardens when offered. Museum short.
